headline: Canes need tipping — 17 days overdue, heat advisory active.
weather_notes: Work before 8 AM today and Tuesday — Heat Advisory active through midnight July 28 with 99°F+ highs closing every afternoon outdoor window.
Run both zones early Tuesday morning — both ran July 26; two days at 99°F with no storm relief means beds are due for rewatering by tomorrow.
Shade e1–e4 tomatoes through midday today — 37-day transplants face sunscald risk after five consecutive days above 99°F.
Limit Thursday outdoor work to pre-dawn — 101°F with 0% precipitation is the hottest day of the week and leaves no safe window past sunrise.
